questions: Does the streaming path sanitize egress PII?
Where should detokenization+sanitization sit, and what does the stream emit?
What holdback keeps a multi-word PII from leaking across the window boundary?

findings.claim: GGUF detokenize + sanitize_output both exist and are reusable
StreamChunk.text already exists; no wire-format change
holdback must be capped (>=H chars) not whitespace-only; multi-word PII (Address/DOB) leaks otherwise
re-detokenize token buffer each step is simplest-correct (UTF-8 via encoding_rs)

decision: 3 forks to operator: sanitize-in-run_stream_sync; emit sanitized text only; holdback H=128 + alnum-run guard
